_comment: Bundled curated database. 'match' is a case-insensitive substring tested against the display name and command. critical_rules always win over known_items and cannot be downgraded by this file's known_items.

critical_rules.explanation: Windows shell. Disabling it breaks the desktop. Core OS entry; never suggested for disabling.
Windows Shell Infrastructure Host. Required for the taskbar and notifications.
Windows Security tray icon. Disabling it hides security status; the protection itself keeps running.
Core Linux service-manager component. Disabling it can leave the session in a broken state.
Desktop message bus. Many applications and the desktop depend on it.
Network connection manager. Disabling it can cut network access at login.

known_items.explanation: Microsoft OneDrive file sync. Starts sync at login; disabling it stops automatic syncing until you start it manually.
Chat app launcher. Safe to disable if you only open Discord when you need it.
Music player. Safe to disable; it only adds a background process at login.
Game client launcher. Safe to disable unless you want updates applied at login.
Microsoft Teams launcher. Safe to disable if you do not want it opening at login.
Software updater. Keeps an application current. Disabling it means updates are only installed when you run a check yourself.
Desktop integration service for sandboxed apps (file pickers, screen sharing). Disabling it can break those features.
